title: Temporal Exposure to Byzantine Vulnerability Under Intermittent Participation in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we study the effect of participation variability on per-round Byzantine vulnerability. We formalise Dynamic Participation Exposure (DPE), a phenomenon in which the global Byzantine fraction remains below an aggregation rule's tolerance threshold, while a participating client set violates, or approaches violation of, the assumptions required for robust aggregation. Under stochastic participation, we derive the probability of per round exposure and analyse how active-set size affects the variability of the observed Byzantine fraction. We further examine the accumulation of exposure over multiple rounds and consider adversaries that selectively participate during favourable rounds. Our analysis shows that intermittent participation does not automatically imply aggregation failure. Rather, it transforms Byzantine robustness from a static population-level property into a stochastic and temporal property. To mitigate this risk,

translated_title: 联邦学习中间歇性参与下的拜占庭脆弱性的时间性暴露
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了参与度的变化对每一轮拜占庭脆弱性的影响。我们形式化了动态参与暴露（Dynamic Participation Exposure, DPE）这一现象：即全局拜占庭比例保持在聚合规则容忍阈值以下，而实际参与的客户端集合却违反或接近违反鲁棒聚合所要求的假设条件。在随机参与条件下，我们推导了每轮发生暴露的概率，并分析了活跃集合规模如何影响所观测到的拜占庭比例的变异性。我们进一步考察了暴露在多轮中的累积效应，并考虑了在有利轮次中选择性参与的对手。我们的分析表明，间歇性参与并不必然导致聚合失败；相反，它将拜占庭鲁棒性从静态的群体层面属性转变为一种随机性和时间性的属性。为缓解这一风险，
tldr: 本文提出动态参与暴露（DPE）概念，揭示联邦学习中的间歇性参与会将拜占庭鲁棒性从静态的群体属性转变为随机的时间性属性，并推导了每轮暴露概率及其多轮累积效应。
en_tdlr: This paper formalises Dynamic Participation Exposure (DPE), showing that intermittent client participation transforms Byzantine robustness in federated learning from a static population-level property into a stochastic and temporal one, and derives per-round exposure probabilities and multi-round accumulation effects.
